# Burlington VT Taxi Ride

## Overview
Burlington VT Taxi Ride is a professional 24/7 car service based in Burlington, Vermont. We specialize in airport transfers, long-distance rides, corporate travel, and ski resort shuttles across Vermont, New England, and into Canada.

## Service Areas
- Burlington International Airport (BTV)
- Montreal-Trudeau (YUL), Boston Logan (BOS), Albany (ALB), JFK, LGA, EWR, and many more
- Vermont destinations: Stowe, Montpelier, Middlebury, Killington, Jay Peak, Sugarbush, Smugglers' Notch, and 100+ towns
- Long-distance transfers to Boston, Montreal, New York airports, and beyond
